clips.label: Opening ten seconds
clips.note: Follow a root bridge into a flowering gateway, then enter the black-and-gold city.
clips.details: First checkpoint for a planned thirty-second journey. The jungle and city begin from independently generated paintings; the crystal world is reserved for the continuation. A short editorial dissolve joins the shots at the threshold. Krea feedback paintings use measured camera paths, followed by local RIFE finishing at 24 fps and native 1536×1024. RIFE is not used across the edit. Silent working cut; fine details continue to repaint.
